'''Vladislav Yakovlevich Panchenko''' ({{langx|ru|Владислав Яковлевич Панченко}}; born 15 September 1947) is a [[Soviet Union|Soviet]] and [[Russians|Russian]] [[scientist]] in the field of laser information technology, scientific instrumentation, nonlinear optics and medical physics, Doctor of Physical and Mathematical Sciences, Professor, Academician of the Russian Academy of Sciences (2008). Chairman of the [[Higher Attestation Commission]] of the Russian Federation, Scientific Director of the Institute of Laser and Information Technology Problems of the Russian Academy of Sciences (ILIT RAS).

==Biography==
He graduated from the [[Moscow State University Faculty of Physics|Physics Department]] of [[Moscow State University]] in 1971, and completed his postgraduate studies there in 1974.

In 1975, he defended his PhD thesis, "Kinetics of Gas Molecule Dissociation under Excitation of Vibrations by Laser Radiation" at the Physics Department of Moscow State University. In 1990, he defended his doctoral thesis, "Nonlinear Absorption of High-Power IR Laser Radiation and Energy Relaxation in Vibrationally Excited Gases."

Since 1985, he has worked at the Institute of Laser and Information Technologies of the Russian Academy of Sciences (IPLT RAS), serving as a department head, division head, and deputy director for research. From 1992 to 2016, he served as director, and is currently the scientific director.

In 1994, he was awarded the academic title of professor. On May 26, 2000, he was elected a Corresponding Member of the [[Russian Academy of Sciences]] in the Department of Informatics, Computer Engineering, and Automation (Information Technology and Telecommunications).

Since 2006, he has been Director of the Institute of Molecular Physics at the [[Kurchatov Institute]] (in parallel with his work at the Institute of Optical Information Technologies).<ref name="kovalchuk">{{cite web |url= https://www.kommersant.ru/doc/3255199 |title= "Дух протеста оказался сильнее разумного понимания сложившейся ситуации" |author=  |publisher= Коммерсант |date= 2017-03-28 |accessdate= 2017-08-10 |archive-date= 2017-08-11 |archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20170811222832/https://www.kommersant.ru/doc/3255199 }}</ref>

On May 28, 2008, he was elected an Academician of the Russian Academy of Sciences in the specialty "nanoelectronics and optical information technologies".

In 2008, he was appointed Chairman of the Council of the Russian Foundation for Basic Research.<ref>[http://www.rian.ru/science/20080616/110654673.html РИА «Новости»] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080619104229/http://www.rian.ru/science/20080616/110654673.html}}: Совет РФФИ возглавил академик Панченко.</ref> In 2010, he became a member of the Advisory Scientific Council of the [[Skolkovo Foundation]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://sk.ru/foundation/team/p/konsultsovet.aspx |title=Сколково. Консультативный научный совет |access-date=2015-10-15 |archive-date=2015-09-28 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150928201144/http://sk.ru/foundation/team/p/konsultsovet.aspx  }}</ref>

Since 2019, he has been Acting Deputy Academician-Secretary and Head of the Nanotechnology Section at the [[Kurchatov Institute]] of the Russian Academy of Sciences. He is also Chairman of the RAS Scientific Council "Fundamental Problems of Nanostructures and Nanotechnologies" (since 2021).

Panchenko heads the Department of Medical Physics<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://medphys.phys.msu.ru/kaf.html |title=Кафедра медицинской физики Физического факультета МГУ им. М. В. Ломоносова |access-date=2017-04-11 |archive-date=2017-05-13 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170513192841/http://medphys.phys.msu.ru/kaf.html }}</ref> at the Physics Faculty of Moscow State University, where he developed and teaches lecture courses on the fundamental principles of laser technology and medical physics.

Since June 13, 2024, he has served as Chairman of the [[Higher Attestation Commission (Russia)|Higher Attestation Commission of the Russian Federation]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://publication.pravo.gov.ru/document/0001202406130023?index=2 |title=Распоряжение Правительства Российской Федерации от 13.06.2024 № 1486-р ∙ Официальное опубликование правовых актов |access-date=2024-06-14 |archive-date=2024-06-18 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240618044501/http://publication.pravo.gov.ru/document/0001202406130023?index=2 }}</ref>

==Election to the Russian Academy of Sciences==
In March 2017, he ran for President of the Russian Academy of Sciences. However, immediately before the election, he withdrew his candidacy (as did the other two candidates, V. E. Fortov and A. A. Makarov), and the elections were postponed<ref name="kovalchuk"/> until the fall. All three candidates agreed that the RAS Charter's deficiencies in regulating the presidential election procedure needed to be addressed.<ref name="withdraw2">{{cite web |url= http://www.interfax.ru/russia/554378 |title= Все участники выборов президента РАН сняли свои кандидатуры |author=  |date= 2017-03-20 |publisher= Интерфакс |access-date= 2017-03-20 |archive-date= 2017-03-20 |archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20170320142539/http://www.interfax.ru/russia/554378 }}</ref>

At the end of April 2017, the Bureau of the RAS Division of Nanotechnology nominated Panchenko as its candidate for the September presidential elections of the Academy.<ref>{{cite web |url= http://www.poisknews.ru/new/24689/ |title= Старт взят |author=  |date= 2017-04-26 |website=  |publisher= Газета «Поиск» |accessdate= 2017-05-27 |language=ru |archive-date= 2017-05-31 |archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20170531085838/http://www.poisknews.ru/new/24689 }}</ref> He completed the approval process with the Russian government, as prescribed by the new rules.<ref name=noChocCher3>{{cite web|url= http://tass.ru/nauka/4522140|title= Кабмин согласовал пять кандидатур на пост президента РАН|author= |publisher= ТАСС|date= 2017-08-31|accessdate= 2017-08-31|archive-date= 2017-09-01|archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20170901021332/http://tass.ru/nauka/4522140}}</ref> Between March and September, scientists expressed polarized opinions on Vladislav Panchenko's chances:<ref name="noballotsept">{{cite web |url= http://www.rbc.ru/society/25/07/2017/5975ef579a7947f0ffbd74ac |title= На выборы главы РАН выдвинулось рекордное число кандидатов |author= П. Звездина |publisher= РБК |date= 2017-07-25 |accessdate= 2017-07-26 |archive-date= 2017-07-25 |archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20170725140538/http://www.rbc.ru/society/25/07/2017/5975ef579a7947f0ffbd74ac }}</ref> from the view that he was "close to the [Russian Federation] presidential administration thanks to his relationship with <…> Mikhail Kovalchuk" through the Kurchatov Institute and had "the greatest chance of winning," to a very low assessment of his chances and condemnation for re-nomination.

Following the first round of elections on September 26, in which only five academicians were admitted, he took fourth place with 204 votes out of 1,596 and did not advance to the second round. The BBC Russian Service characterized this result and the election of [[Alexander Sergeev (physicist)|Alexander Sergeev]] as President of the [[Russian Academy of Sciences]] as "the Kovalchuks lost".<ref name="BBCKovalch">{{cite web |url= http://www.bbc.com/russian/news-41404014 |title= Кандидат от Ковальчуков проиграл выборы президента РАН |author= С. Горяшко |publisher= Русская служба Би-би-си |date= 2017-09-26 |accessdate= 2017-09-27 |archive-date= 2017-09-29 |archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20170929061453/http://www.bbc.com/russian/news-41404014  }}</ref> Nevertheless, Panchenko was elected to the new Presidium of the Russian Academy of Sciences in 2017.<ref name=ViboriPresidiuma>{{cite web|url= https://indicator.ru/news/2017/09/28/prezidium-ran/|title= Члены РАН избрали президиум Академии|author= |publisher= Сайт «Indicator.Ru»|date= 2017-09-28|accessdate= 2017-09-28|archive-date= 2017-09-29|archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20170929044639/https://indicator.ru/news/2017/09/28/prezidium-ran/}}</ref>

His son is entrepreneur Yakov Panchenko, co-owner of the firm "Debruss". His daughter-in-law is Olga Panchenko, daughter of entrepreneur [[Vladimir Alyoshin]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.vedomosti.ru/business/articles/2015/12/02/619363-univermagov-debenhams-medizdelii |title=ВЕДОМОСТИ — От универмагов Debenhams до медицинских изделий |date=2 December 2015 |access-date=2016-10-05 |archive-date=2016-10-11 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161011102545/https://www.vedomosti.ru/business/articles/2015/12/02/619363-univermagov-debenhams-medizdelii }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=https://life.ru/t/%D1%88%D0%BE%D1%83/343721 |title=Постаревший Влад Сташевский заработал мусорным бизнесом на «хаммер» (ФОТО) — «Life.ru» — информационный портал |date=8 April 2015 |access-date=2022-07-23 |archive-date=2016-10-06 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161006170028/https://life.ru/t/%D1%88%D0%BE%D1%83/343721 }}</ref>

==Academic research==
{{BLP unreferenced section|date=September 2025}}
Vladislav Panchenko is a specialist in laser physics, nonlinear optics, laser information technology, nanotechnology, and medical physics. He has conducted pioneering work in the physics of laser-matter interactions and created new laser information and technological systems, including for medical applications. Under his leadership, unique systems for the remote fabrication of individual implants and biomodels based on tomographic data from preoperative patient examinations transmitted via a high-speed internet connection to a rapid prototyping center were developed. He also developed original laser rapid prototyping systems, including stereolithography units, selective [[sintering]] of micro- and nanopowders, and purification in supercritical fluids.

Preoperative biomodeling technologies developed with Panchenko's participation have been implemented in neurosurgery, oncology, and reconstructive surgery. Pre-planning of surgeries using plastic biomodels significantly reduces time and improves treatment outcomes in oncology, neurosurgery, maxillofacial surgery, reconstructive surgery, and other fields, and has opened up new possibilities in [[pediatric surgery]].

A group led by Vladislav Panchenko has created a new generation of intelligent laser surgical systems that can determine in real time the type of tissue being removed and the boundaries of the surgical site. These systems offer new opportunities for minimally invasive and organ-preserving surgeries.
